latin: Sicut non omne corpus, sed perfectum anima participat, ita non omnis anima sed perfecta intellectu participat; omnia tamen uno participant.
translation: Just as not every body, but only a perfect body, participates in soul, so not every soul, but only a perfect soul, participates in intellect; yet all things participate in the One.
